title: Seal deterministic sandbox evidence snapshot
goal: Create a deterministic sandbox-only evidence snapshot whose root digest binds the verified RCE reconstruction index and authoritative receipt chain without deleting evidence or granting production, execution, or destination-mutation authority.
acceptance_criteria: P0-009 authoritative receipt is present and true
snapshot binds the reconstruction index digest and every indexed entry digest and byte count
snapshot root is deterministic for unchanged evidence
missing or changed indexed evidence fails closed
snapshot is candidate evidence only and sandbox only
production installation external destination mutation and autonomous execution remain prohibited
blocked_by: RCE-P0-009 authoritative reconstruction-index receipt not yet persisted
